mappings.note: Science as facts PLUS the processes that produce them. No LO states that claim: C7.1-LO-5 covers only the revisability half, so the inquiry competency is cited.

Careful observation (magnifying glass). None of the five C8.2 outcomes covers observation itself - they are testable questions, predictions, estimation, uncertainty - so the competency, which names using instruments and representing data, is cited.
